subject: Commit sync: annual -> flex uplift orchestration
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@helixhealth.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commit sync: annual -> flex uplift orchestration

Hi Erin / Samir,

Thanks again for taking time last week. I pulled together a simple proposal to align HelixHealth's renewal window with your other cloud contracts and create a graduated upsell path that smooths consumption while giving predictable unit economics for both sides. High level: 

- Move from a single annual commit to a 24-month "flex" commitment with annual true-ups.
- Year 1: conservative baseline (90% of current annualized usage) + burst buffer; Year 2: graduated uplift (110% baseline) to accommodate ramp.
- Pricing: blended rate with a 10% volume discount for committing to 24 months; optional upfront credit for onboarding.
- Billing: quarterly invoicing with annual reconciliation / true-up.

I've attached your Q2 usage so we have the baseline numbers. Request: can you confirm whether a co-term with your data platform vendor (end-of-year) is required, and share any procurement constraints early (procurement contact, preferred billing cadence)?

If that sounds reasonable, I propose a 30-minute alignment call early next week to run numbers and lock the amendment draft.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119
[Attachment: Helix_Usage_Report_Q2.csv]

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@helixhealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@helixhealth.ai>, procurements@helixhealth.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit sync: annual -> flex uplift orchestration

Jonas —

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifying Qs from the Helix side before we set a meeting:

1) What exactly does the quarterly invoicing + annual true-up look like operationally? We need the amendment to spell out the calculation and reporting cadence for our finance team.
2) We do have a preferred co-term with our data platform (ends 12/31). Can you co-term to 12/31 without prorating the first year heavily?
3) Procurement asked if you can provide a draft amendment and an estimate in DocuSign-friendly format. Also need a short list of SLAs tied to burst capacity (latency/availability) to include in the purchase order.

Looping procurement; Samir will lead on the internal side. Can Kimberly and Rishi be available next Tuesday 8/10 for a 30m call?

Erin Walsh
Head of Data Platforms | HelixHealth
erin.walsh@helixhealth.ai | +1 212-555-7821
[Procurement note attached: Procurements_govt_template.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@helixhealth.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit sync: annual -> flex uplift orchestration

Erin —

Thanks for the detailed asks. Attaching a working amendment (Draft_Amendment_v3.docx) that captures: billing cadence, true-up formula, co-term mechanics, and SLA bullets for burst capacity. Key points to note: 

- True-up: measured against monthly consumption averaged into quarterly buckets; reconciliation occurs at contract anniversary (co-term date). Any overage billed at published overage rate; underuse credit applied to next period.
- Co-term: we can align to 12/31 with a prorated initial period based on utilization; alternative option is to frontload credits to avoid a large prorate that impacts your cashflow.
- SLA: 99.9% availability for committed pools; burst availability best-effort with 1-hour ramp SLA for pre-warned bursts (we can move to 30m for premium support).

I included a pricing appendix that models the 24-month blended rate and the 10% discount for the commit. If you want, we can produce a second appendix showing a strict 12-month annual renewal vs the 24-month flex — makes it easy to compare TCO.

Regards,

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Draft_Amendment_v3.docx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@helixhealth.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit sync: annual -> flex uplift orchestration

Erin / Samir —

Great — thanks Rishi for the quick turn. A few pragmatic suggestions to keep procurement happy and accelerate signature: 

- Offer A: 24-month flex, 10% discount, quarterly billing, annual true-up, co-term to 12/31 with frontloaded onboarding credits to offset prorate impact.
- Offer B: 12-month annual with higher per-unit price but no prorate complexity — useful if procurement prefers simpler accounting.

Operational asks from Helix to confirm prior to the call: preferred PO holder name, whether you need Net-30 vs Net-45, and which internal Slack channel we should use for burst capacity pre-warn. Once we have those, Rishi and I will finalize the DocuSign-ready amendment and pricing appendix.

I can do Tue 8/10 10–10:30 PT; Kimberly can cover technical ops and Rishi will join for pricing.

Thanks,

Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Helix_Usage_Report_Q2.csv]

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@helixhealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: procurements@helixhealth.ai
Date: 2027-08-06T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit sync: annual -> flex uplift orchestration

Jonas / Erin —

Quick update from Helix procurement: the team prefers Offer A if we can lock the co-term to 12/31 without a cash-heavy prorate. Legal will review Rishi's draft and return any redlines next week. We also need a formal DocuSign estimate (line-itemed) and a short SLA addendum for burst guarantees to attach to the PO.

Procurement has uploaded our standard procurement template to the thread (see Procurements_Guidelines.pdf). Can you produce the DocuSign link with the amendment + pricing appendix by EOD Friday 8/13? Once legal is satisfied, we should be able to sign and schedule phased capacity increases starting Oct 1.

Samir Gupta
Senior Procurement Manager | HelixHealth
samir.gupta@helixhealth.ai
[Attachment: Procurement_Guidelines.pdf]
